description: Get all available TTS voices. Optionally filter by language code (e.g. "en-US", "zh-CN", "ja-JP") or gender ("Female", "Male"). Returns voice IDs needed for text_to_speech.

gender.description: Filter by gender: "Female" or "Male". Leave empty for all.

language.description: Filter by language code, e.g. "en-US", "zh-CN", "ja-JP", "es-ES". Leave empty for all voices.

name: list_voices
title: List Available Voices
